rules.name: Existence checks should use ".includes()" instead of ".indexOf()" or ".lastIndexOf()"
Agentic workflows should not be vulnerable to path injection attacks
Alternatives in regular expressions should be grouped when used with anchors
Array methods ".find()" and ".findLast()" should be preferred over ".filter()" for single element retrieval
Unnecessary fallback objects should not be used when spreading in object literals
Confidential data should not be sent in HTTP GET parameters
"Array.prototype.sort()" and "Array.prototype.toSorted()" should use a compare function
Dynamic code execution should not use user-controlled data
Client-side requests should not be vulnerable to forging attacks
Jump statements should not be redundant
Server-side requests should not be vulnerable to traversing attacks
String literals with escaped backslashes should use `String.raw` template literals
Regular expressions should not cause non-linear backtracking
